mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200 units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 1200.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, regardless of other market conditions.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 5% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, the combined labor market strength predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 2% YoY, indicating a strong supply side, supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially during monetary tightening cycles.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real disposable personal income (RSAFS) growth exceeding 5% YoY, signaling robust demand, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, particularly in post-shock recovery regimes.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the CPI (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% in 3 months, indicating rising inflation expectations, would lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate tighter monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5% in 2 months and payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth slows to less than 100,000, the combined labor market weakness predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increase > 0.5% in 2 months and PAYEMS growth < 100,000
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth slowing to less than 1% YoY, indicating weakening demand, would lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, especially in late-cycle expansion regimes.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this mechanism remains above 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
